scope: Explicit reproduction targets and remaining evidence; no case is represented as reproduced.

cases.title: H + CH4 -> H2 + CH3
required_scientific_reviews: Exact PES/version and isotope masses match the reference; archive model bytes and licenses.
Electronic, nuclear-spin and equivalent-channel conventions match; never reapply factors already in the table.
Inspect PMF overlap, correlated uncertainty including PMF and recrossing, and the full transmission plateau.
Check replica independence, source integrity, and all rate outputs with benchmarks/published_rates/compare.py.
blockers: Historical Espinosa-Garcia PES source/license/hash and matching model build are not supplied by this campaign.
Converged methane trajectories have not been run; a modern PIP-NN PES is a separate benchmark.

cases.title: H surface diffusion on Ni(100)
required_scientific_reviews: Match the exact metal/hydrogen model, isotope, lattice constant, coverage or loading and movable/frozen layers.
Separate two-dimensional surface diffusion from three-dimensional bulk diffusion and finite-cluster escape.
Inspect unwrapped centroid MSD and VACF, drift subtraction, fit windows and independent-replica error bars.
Transcribe a source-matched table or digitized curve with uncertainty and provenance before comparison.
blockers: Existing NiAlH_jea EAM software pilot does not match the lattice/PES specification of the 2012 study.
Reference values remain unavailable; no number is manufactured from a plot or a short ballistic trajectory.

cases.title: q-TIP4P/F H2O self-diffusion at 298 K
required_scientific_reviews: Match 216 molecules, density 0.997 g/cm3, temperature, isotope masses, unthermostatted physical production and the source finite-size convention.
Match or converge the 9-A short-range cutoff, long-range electrostatics and tail corrections; never impose rigid bonds on q-TIP4P/F.
Establish liquid equilibrium (structure and stationarity), unwrapped molecular-centroid VACF/MSD consistency, plateau and independent replica uncertainty.
Compare the finite 216-molecule diffusion value separately from an infinite-size extrapolation; finite-size dependence is expected.
blockers: The model factory and tiny periodic integration pilot are available; a source-sized equilibrated liquid campaign has not been run.
The P=4 eight-molecule pilot and its 2.5-A cutoff cannot be compared quantitatively with the paper.

cases.title: q-TIP4P/F liquid infrared spectrum (cross-method comparison)
required_scientific_reviews: Original Figure 5 is PA-CMD; TRPMD/RPMD spectra are method comparisons, not implementation agreement with PA-CMD.
Evaluate whole-molecule dipoles on each bead and average dipoles; preserve a flexible O-H potential.
Compare full bending/stretching/librational bands, not just a fitted peak, using archived source curves and explicit broadening/normalization.
Converge thermostat friction for TRPMD, cadence/Nyquist frequency, record length, window function and liquid equilibrium; relative IR is not absolute absorbance.
blockers: No source digitization or source-sized liquid production spectrum has been generated.
The tiny pilot outputs an RPMD spectrum diagnostic only; it is neither PA-CMD nor a physically converged liquid IR result.
